#### Creating time_years and event column for KM and CPH analysis ####

# Need to define time_months column and event column

# Creating the time_months column

SGLT2$mi2_months <- time_length(interval(SGLT2$randomisation_dte, SGLT2$mi_dte), "months")

SGLT2$trial_months <- time_length(interval(SGLT2$randomisation_dte, SGLT2$endfup_dte), "months")

SGLT2$time_months <- ifelse(!is.na(SGLT2$mi2_months), SGLT2$mi2_months, SGLT2$trial_months)

# Converting to time_years

SGLT2$time_years <- SGLT2$time_months/12


# Event column is mi_flg column (1 <- had MI, 0 <- did not have MI)
# Participants without a secondary MI were censored at the end of follow-up (5 years post-randomisation)

#### Overall KM 5 year free MI plot ####

library(survminer)
library(survival)

overall_km <- survfit(Surv(time_years, mi_flg) ~ 1, data = SGLT2)

summary(overall_km)

ggsurvplot(
  overall_km,
  data = SGLT2,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  pval = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  xlab = "Time (years)",
  ylab = "Secondary MI-free Probability",
  title = "Secondary MI-free Proability Kaplan-Meier Plot",
  ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)


summary(overall_km)$table

# Analysis of MI free probability at 1.5 years and 5 years

summary(overall_km, times = c(1.5, 5))

#### Kaplan Meier plot for event (secondary MI) comparing usual care and SGLT2 arms ####

# Turning allocation into a factor and specifying reference (Usual care)

SGLT2$alloc_factor <- factor(
  SGLT2$alloc,
  levels = c("Usual Care", "SGLT2"))

# Creating KM plot based on allocation

mi_arms_km <- survfit(Surv(time_years, mi_flg) ~ alloc_factor, data = SGLT2)

summary(mi_arms_km)

ggsurvplot(
  mi_arms_km,
  data = SGLT2,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  pval = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  xlim = c(0, 5),
  xlab = "Time (years)",
  ylab = "Secondary MI-free Probability",
  legend.labs = c("Usual care", "SGLT2 inhibitor"),
  legend.title = "Treatment arms",
  title = "Secondary MI-free Probability against Treatment Arms Kaplan-Meier Plot",
  ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)


survdiff(Surv(time_years, mi_flg) ~ alloc_factor, data = SGLT2)

summary(mi_arms_km, times = c(1.5, 5))


##### Cox proportional hazards plot ####

# Creating unadjusted CPH plot 

cox_unadjusted <- coxph(Surv(time_years, mi_flg) ~ alloc, data = SGLT2)

summary(cox_unadjusted)

# Creating adjusted CPH plot

cox_adjusted <- coxph(Surv(time_months, mi_flg) ~  alloc + sex + age + sbp_bl + bmi_bl, data = SGLT2)

summary(cox_adjusted)


#### Checking Schoenfeld residual test for CPH####

cox.zph(cox_unadjusted)

cox.zph(cox_adjusted)

# Alloc violated in both tests <- already dealt with in time splits


#### Sensitivity analyses for CPH ####

# Time split model (split at 0 - 1.5 years and 1.5 - 5 years)

SGLT2_split <- survSplit(data  = SGLT2,
                         cut   = 1.5,
                         end   = "time_years",
                         event = "mi_flg",
                         start = "tstart",
                         id    = "split_id")

SGLT2_split$period <- ifelse(SGLT2_split$tstart == 0,
  "Early (<1.5y)",
  "Late (>=1.5y)")


SGLT2_split$period <- factor(
  SGLT2_split$period,
  levels = c("Early (<1.5y)", "Late (>=1.5y)")
)

cox_time_adj <- coxph(Surv(tstart, time_years, mi_flg) ~ alloc * period + sex + age + sbp_bl + bmi_bl, data = SGLT2_split)

summary(cox_time_adj)

# calculating late period alloc HR and CIs

b <- coef(cox_time_adj)
V <- vcov(cox_time_adj)

beta_early <- b["allocUsual Care"]
beta_int  <- b["allocUsual Care:periodLate (>=1.5y)"]

beta_late <- beta_early + beta_int

se_late <- sqrt(
  V["allocUsual Care","allocUsual Care"] +
    V["allocUsual Care:periodLate (>=1.5y)","allocUsual Care:periodLate (>=1.5y)"] +
    2*V["allocUsual Care","allocUsual Care:periodLate (>=1.5y)"]
)

HR_late <- exp(beta_late)
CI_late <- exp(beta_late + c(-1,1)*1.96*se_late)

HR_late
CI_late

# Creating interaction between treatment arm and sex

cox_sex <- coxph(Surv(time_years, mi_flg) ~   alloc + sex + age + sbp_bl + bmi_bl + alloc * sex, data = SGLT2)

summary(cox_sex)

# SE and HR

se <- sqrt((0.250156**2) + (0.264194**2))
log_hr <-  0.142948 + 0.129070 

exp(log_hr)

# 95% CI

exp(log_hr - se * 1.96)
exp(log_hr + se * 1.96)

##### CPH model fit check (analysis of deviance) ####

# SGLT2 effect varies over time --> cox_time_adj

# create SGLT effect is constant model

cox_constant <- coxph(Surv(tstart, time_years, mi_flg) ~ alloc + period + sex + age + sbp_bl + bmi_bl, data = SGLT2_split)

anova(cox_constant, cox_time_adj, test = "LRT")
